intro: Oh, hi.
You know, that argument you had today with r_c:0 was stupid.
You were both entitled. And you didn't end it, which doesn't make you better than {PRONOUN/r_c:0/object}.
Then I had to step in, which was unnecessary, because it was stupid.
You were spitting words at each other for nothing. It was uncalled for.
And I'm not afraid to tell you so.
Huh? Oh, nothing's wrong ...
Just ... had a bad day, is all ...
*Sigh* y_c, have you ever felt like you're not enough for anyone?
Usually, when it comes to making a decision, I never hesitate. Whatever the obstacle, I'll run headfirst into it, no questions asked.

But, today, when negotiating with an enemy Clan, I said something risky and it completely backfired. Luckily, I was able to smooth things over, but because of me, the Clan could've been hurt, or worse.
I just feel like such a failure. A liability. Everycat in the Clan is depending on me, but what if I keep falling short?
[You offer t_c words of reassurance, but {PRONOUN/t_c/subject} {VERB/t_c/seem/seems} troubled beyond comforting.]
[Still, you sit with {PRONOUN/t_c/object} through the night, hoping to stabilize {PRONOUN/t_c/object} through whatever storm {PRONOUN/t_c/subject} might be weathering right now.]

Sorry. Couldn't tell you. You'll have to go see for yourself.
I swear to StarClan, next time r_c:0 comes to me asking for assurance that some random cat doesn't hate {PRONOUN/r_c:0/object}, I just might have to claw my own ears off.

I tell {PRONOUN/r_c:0/object} over and over, 'all you have to do is ask', but {PRONOUN/r_c:0/subject} never {VERB/r_c:0/do/does}. Just {VERB/r_c:0/apologize/apologizes} over and over for stuff {PRONOUN/r_c:0/subject} {VERB/r_c:0/don't/doesn't} know {PRONOUN/r_c:0/subject} even did.

Hm? What's that, y_c?
You ... want us to do a bonding exercise, to get to know each other better as mentor and apprentice?
Ha. Please.
[t_c stalks off before you can even finish explaining the exercise. Clearly, you'll need to find another way of getting through to {PRONOUN/t_c/object} ...]
[You notice your apprentice is looking a little stressed, and ask {PRONOUN/t_c/object} how {PRONOUN/t_c/subject}{VERB/t_c/'re/'s} feeling.]

Look, can we get one thing straight, y_c? I'm your apprentice, you're my mentor, that's it. That's all this has to be.
We don't need to get into any of the 'feelings' stuff, because it really isn't necessary. Got it?
[{PRONOUN/t_c/subject/CAP} {VERB/t_c/storm/storms} off, lashing {PRONOUN/t_c/poss} tail. If that isn't the most brutal little cat you've ever met in your life ...]

[For such a young cat, t_c sure doesn't mince words ...]

[t_c casts a glance at {PRONOUN/t_c/poss} mentor over {PRONOUN/t_c/poss} shoulder, then turns back to you with a rare smile.]

y_c? You're here again?
No. I refuse. You always come here, always have some banal argument for me to mediate.
Have you ever considered that maybe you're the problem?
You wouldn't have so much work for me if you didn't start so many discussions and provocations. Most of the time you're not even in the right.
You're obnoxious, annoying, stupid and self-absorbed. There, that's the answer. Now, kindly leave me to go find something worth my time.
[t_c just refused to help you out. But {PRONOUN/t_c/subject} can't do that ... Can {PRONOUN/t_c/subject}?]
Hm ...
[For a mediator, t_c sure doesn't seem to talk much.]

Hey, what does this herb do? Can I eat it?
Haha, don't look so stressed! I was just joking.
Hey, y_c ... is it really true that you can talk to StarClan?
Whoa! That's so cool! What does StarClan say that I'm gonna do? Am I gonna be strong? Am I destined for greatness?
... It doesn't work like that? Awh. That's no fun.
Well, if StarClan ever mentions me, you'll let me know, won't you?
y_c. Buddy. Best friend. We've GOTTA TRY this. r_c:0 told me that if you eat three mice, one rabbit, and howl at the moon, you get magic powers!
What? It's totally real, {PRONOUN/r_c:0/subject} wouldn't lie to me like that! I prommissseee.
HEY!!! You leave them alone!
Ugh. Can you believe how cruel some cats are, y_c? A bunch of apprentices were trying to convince these two kits to sneak into a badger den ... what a bunch of mouse-brains.
No matter what, don't let anyone try to pressure you into doing something you don't think is right. Go with your gut, and stick to your own values. That's what's really important.
Hey there, y_c! Not bad weather today, hm?

[You hear t_c quietly groan to {PRONOUN/t_c/self} from the other side of the clearing.]

I got into an argument with another cat from o_c_n about their current plans. They refused to listen to me when I had a better solution to their problem.
Makes me almost regret being a mediator. I hate talking to other cats, they're just utterly full of problems they create for themselves, and they refuse to listen to obvious solutions.
But, I suppose I became a mediator apprentice to help other cats with their problems too. I suppose I've caught my mouse and I need to eat it.
Thank you for listening to me, y_c. I'll keep thinking of another solution they'll like.
[You're sitting staring at a piece of fresh kill, when you feel something nudge into your shoulder, you turn your head to see t_c.]
y_c? ... Are you okay?
You look a little... out of it. Are you feeling unwell? Do you want me to take you over to the medicine den?
... You heard a cat you have a crush on flirting with someone else? Oh, y_c. I'm so, so sorry.
I think you're a wonderful cat, anyone would be truly lucky to be with you. If they can't see how great you are, that's their loss.
... I could talk to them, give them a poke into your direction, but I don't want to get too involved in your love life, you're plenty capable on your own.
I'd give yourself a break, and hold your head high, prove to them the cat you are.
When you grow up, you won't cause any problems for me, right y_c?
[t_c is sitting in the corner of camp, staring off into space.]
y_c...? How long have you been there for?
What's wrong? It's nothing. Really.
I'm just working through some advice my mentor gave to me earlier. It... makes sense in concept, I'm just having difficulty really wrapping my mind around it.
Huh? Oh, they told me that, in order for me to be able to help cats get along, I need to taste my own medicine and try to get along with people too.
I didn't think that I really... didn't get along with other cats. I care about the other cats in the Clan! It's my job!
... You think that's my problem? That I view others as people to help, rather than as friends? Is that what my mentor meant?
I never thought about that. I'll have to try getting to know other cats, try and make some friends. Thank you for your thoughts, y_c.
... y_c? Is everything okay? I'm surprised you came out of your way to find me. Is there anything I can help with?

I'm not busy at all. I'm always here to lend an ear to any member of my Clan, from the leader to the littlest kit. We can go to the edge of the clearing if you wish to speak privately, pretend we're sharing tongues.

If it makes you feel any better, you're teaching me as I'm listening. You're allowing me to know what kind of problems everycat has, so I'm more able to help, and so I can suggest things to make everycat's day better.
'The more I hear, the more I know. The more I know, the further I go.' If I'm making a phrase about it.
That's advice I can give to you, no matter what. You'll only know if you try it, y_c.
Unless it's breaking the Warrior Code. Please don't do that.
[t_c is pacing back and forth near the camp entrance.]
... Huh? Oh hi there. Sorry, I'll get out of the way.
... No, no. I'm okay. Just preparing to go to o_c_n. My mentor asked me to go discuss with their mediator about an agreement we've been having about borders.
I know they sent me, because they know I'm completely capable, and o_c_n is mostly willing to cooperate in this manner, but I'm still worried about it.
I just need to do it. I need to go do my job as a mediator, and go solve this problem. Take the sparrow by the wings, so to speak.
Standing here wearing my paws into the floor is only giving me sore paw pads and a future trip to the medicine den. I'll see you later, y_c.
[t_c is sat watching two of your Clanmates argue with each other, with fascination.]
[One of them calls the other a half-Clan foxheart. Quite brutal. Why is t_c not saying anything?]
[... A giant jaybird flies out of a tree just behind the arguing cats.]
[t_c seems to come to awareness of what's going on around {PRONOUN/t_c/object}, and {PRONOUN/t_c/subject} {VERB/t_c/rush/rushes} over to deal with the yelling cats.]
*Sigh*. Hey, y_c. Come to ruin the fun again?
Whatever. I'm going to go do something actually exciting. Don't wait up.
I'll make you proud, y_c!
I'll make all of c_n proud!
y_c, can you believe it? I actually got to mediate a real, serious argument today! Eeee, so cool!!!
I mean, uh, definitely not cool. I'm definitely very serious and respectful towards my sacred duty to my Clan.
... Is r_c:0 still there?
Er, sorry, y_c. I can't chat right now ...
r_c:0 really needs me to mediate this argument, and I kinda actually have to focus.
I'll come and find you as soon as I'm free, though, okay?
Knowing what we know from mediating their conflicts, if everycat in camp got into a fight ... Who d'you think would win?
Can be mental. Or physical. Either option would be interesting.
Personally, I'm betting on r_c:0 ... in both categories.
[t_c stumbles across camp to you, soaking wet and covered in mud.]
y_c! Before you get mad, I didn't do it!
[The very peeved-off looking deputy locks eyes with you and storms in your direction. What mischief did t_c get into this time?]

[t_c lays a colorful feather at your paws.]

Go find some other cat to impose on.
Kits bickering again? *Sigh* I hear ya ...
Hard to reason with cats whose brains are basically still mush. But kits are actually a lot more emotionally aware than you may realize.
All they want is to feel seen and understood, just like you or I or any other cat. When you don't take the time to listen to them, that's when they really lash out.
Try speaking to them like adults, respecting their feelings, and keeping in mind that they won't be able to communicate as well as we can.
You got it, y_c!
y_c, I know the kits fight a lot, but maybe you don't have to come to me for everything?

How about, just this once, you try helping the kits resolve their quarrels on your own?
And if you mess up, I'll be right here to help you. It is my job, after all! *Wink*
I have my first meeting with another Clan today ... wish me luck, will ya?
When I get back, I'll tell you all about the other Clan's territory! Their leader, their prey ... Everything you've ever wondered about!
Don't wait up, huh? I'll be back before you know it!
[You ask t_c why {PRONOUN/t_c/subject} chose to become a mediator, given {PRONOUN/t_c/poss} adventurous personality.]

[t_c brandishes a colorful, exotic flower and lays it at your paws.]

y_c! Before you get mad, I didn't do it!
